decided: Ship the contributor intake surface as GitHub *issue forms* (YAML, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*.yml) with required fields, not classic Markdown templates, and turn the blank issue box off in config.yml so the chooser is the only entrance. Four files land: 1-bug-report.yml, 2-adapter-request.yml, 3-question-or-docs-gap.yml, config.yml, plus .github/pull_request_template.md. Security is deliberately NOT a template: config.yml routes it to SECURITY.md's private advisory channel as contact links. No file under .github/workflows/ is touched.
why: The bead's whole premise is that a bare issue box yields 'the number looks wrong' with no registry, no adapters, no window - and a round trip before triage can start. A classic Markdown template is prefilled prose a reporter can delete; an issue form's required: true is the only mechanism GitHub offers that makes the answer arrive with the report. The field set is chosen from what actually decides a shortfall triage: which query adapter is wired decides which legs could be grounded at all, and whether any leg reported NotAvailable (ADR-0017's Leg.Unavailable, rendered n/a) separates designed degradation from a defect - the single field that closes the largest share of 'the number looks wrong' reports without a round trip. The adapter form mirrors query.Caps{Metrics, Events} and the four question shapes a Querier must translate (QueryMetric; QueryEvents groups / distinct_count / max_per_group) because those are precisely what decides adapter feasibility. Leaving the blank box on would let the shape this bead exists to prevent walk straight back in; the question/docs-gap form is deliberately broad enough to be the catch-all.
cost_if_wrong: Low and fully reversible. These are inert repository metadata: no CI job reads them, no gate depends on them, and nothing under .github/workflows/ changes, so the worst case is a chooser that asks slightly wrong questions - fixed by editing YAML in a follow-up PR of the same class. The one live risk is friction: too many required fields could deter a genuine reporter. Mitigated by keeping the question/docs-gap form to two required fields and by making every bug-report required field one a reporter already has in front of them. If blank_issues_enabled: false proves hostile in practice, flipping it back is a one-line change.
alternatives: Classic Markdown issue templates - rejected: no required fields, so the reporter can submit the empty shape the bead exists to prevent.
Leave blank_issues_enabled: true - rejected: it reopens the bare box; the question form is the catch-all instead.

A security issue template - rejected by the bead and by SECURITY.md: a public issue is the wrong channel for a vulnerability, so config.yml links the private advisory form and the security policy instead.

Restate CONTRIBUTING's checks and attestation contract inside the PR template - rejected under ADR-0008 clause 5 (one standard, one wording): the template links CONTRIBUTING.md rather than creating a second wording that can drift.
scope: Additive only, entirely under .github/ outside workflows/. Touches no Go code, no docs/, no README.md, no adapters/ - all of which other agents hold concurrently. This bead is itself the tracked item that .warden/skills-policy.md's Forbidden paths section requires for a gate-surface change (explicitly about policy/CI/enrollment); it exists as a separate bead for that reason, and the PR body states so and shows the empty .github/workflows/ diff.
